facts.business: Godavari Drugs Limited manufactures pharmaceutical APIs and intermediates, with a new facility for Anti-HIV intermediates under production trials, and is pursuing CDMO/CMO partnerships.

capacity_or_capex.item: New state-of-the-art manufacturing facility for Anti-HIV intermediates
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Currently under production trials and stabilization

guidance_or_targets.statement: Commercialise new products, ramp up new manufacturing capacities, grow exports, strengthen backward integration, and continue diversifying product portfolio

key_risks: Competition and pricing pressures in the API segment
Dependence on successful commercialization of new products and ramp-up of new manufacturing capacities
Execution risk in diversifying product portfolio and building CDMO/CMO partnerships
